world_news_real.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
world_news_real.description: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

world_news_real.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
world_news_real.description: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

world_news_real.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
world_news_real.description: It is the latest strike in a long trade war, and comes after Canadian counter-tariffs on US goods come into force.

world_news_real.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange strikes as two killed at Moldova border
world_news_real.description: Meanwhile, four people, including a child, were killed in the southern Russian city of Novorossiysk.

world_news_real.title: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
world_news_real.description: The International Atomic Energy Agency's says the facility is cause for "serious concern".

world_news_real.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
world_news_real.description: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.

world_news_real.title: Colombia's new president loosens gun control rules
world_news_real.description: President Abelardo de la Espriella has lifted a decade-long suspension on permits to carry legal firearms.

world_news_real.title: Family of killed teen call for death penalty in D4vd trial
world_news_real.description: The parents of Celeste Rivas Hernandez say execution "would be perfect" if D4vd is found guilty.

world_news_real.title: White House pulls Tetris-style 'Build The Wall' game after copyright concern
world_news_real.description: The Tetris Company says it takes "copyright infringement very seriously" and is not involved with the game.

world_news_real.title: Baby orangutans found in Indian forest spark trafficking inquiry
world_news_real.description: The critically endangered apes were found far from their natural habitat in the eastern Indian state of Odisha.
